verdict.rationale: Fastmail has its own help article titled "Calendar events and invitations," and a community comment confirms it offers a Fastmail calendar, so first-party calendar and invite handling exists. However, the pack contains only that title, with no detail on viewing the calendar, RSVPing, or creating events from within the mail interface. missing for 10: documented in-mail invite RSVP flow, evidence of event creation and calendar viewing without leaving the email client, hands-on or independent corroboration of the integrated workflow.
